address: 24 Gongjie Lane, Licheng, Quanzhou, China Mainland
bio: Tucked away in an alley, the restaurant is rather hard to find, but look for the small courtyard under a big tree. It is the epitome of vintage and adorned in splendid antique pieces. The menu is also a picture of nostalgia. Yongchun taro noodle soup boasts creamy mashed taro in flavorsome broth. Stir-fried pork liver is cooked perfectly, both tender and crispy. Ask for a table in the courtyard on a sunny day....
